verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists a native Chat product alongside planning features like Sprints. A community user confirms 'ClickUp does have real-time chat,' and the docs reference Chat views via the API and Figma embeds in Chat, so team conversation happens in the same tool used to plan work. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of chat capabilities (channels, DMs, threads), and explicit evidence of how chat links to tasks and sprints.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: The ClickUp API allows you to view, add, and update or delete comments on tasks, Lists, and Chat views.
Embed interactive Figma prototypes in ClickUp Tasks, Docs, and Chat for real-time design collaboration.
